integrity: The exact polynomial identities and high-precision numerical coefficient are independently checked by a standalone checker. Finite computations are not treated as a proof of global positivity or a U-statistic CLT.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the uncensored fixed-support signed U-statistic and its null-normal cutoff, not to Kaplan-Meier versions, fitted endpoints, or the different squared characterization statistics. Fixed-alternative limit; historical priority not independently certified.
title: A smooth blind manifold for a uniformity U-statistic with subnominal limiting power
